meta_title: The Garden Guru | Garden Design & Maintenance Nottingham
meta_description: The Garden Guru transforms Nottingham gardens with expert design, landscaping, and seasonal care. Free quotes. Call 07932 670281 today.
hero_eyebrow: Expert Garden Design & Landscaping — Serving Nottingham
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to stunning outdoor spaces, we design and maintain gardens that boost your home's appeal and give you back your weekends.
services_subhead: Whether you need a complete garden overhaul, regular maintenance, or specialist landscaping, we've got your outdoor space covered.

services.title: Garden Design & Landscaping
services.desc: Bespoke garden designs tailored to your space, style, and budget. We handle everything from layout and planting schemes to pathways and water features.

services.title: Seasonal Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Regular weekly or fortnightly visits keep your borders tidy, lawns healthy, and plants thriving. Prune, deadhead, and weed on a schedule that suits you.

services.title: Lawn Care & Restoration
services.desc: Scarifying, aeration, overseeding, and moss treatment bring tired lawns back to life. Enjoy a thick, green sward without the weekend work.

services.title: Tree & Hedge Pruning
services.desc: Professional shaping and maintenance of trees, hedges, and shrubs keeps them healthy and under control. Safe, experienced, fully insured.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Tidy-Ups
services.desc: Overgrown borders, old beds, and general clutter removed quickly and responsibly. We leave your garden clean, cleared, and ready for replanting.

services.title: Planting & Bed Creation
services.desc: We source plants suited to your soil and light conditions, then plant and establish new beds so they thrive. Year-round colour and interest guaranteed.

about_pullquote: I started this because I love seeing people reclaim their gardens and actually use them.
about_para_1: The Garden Guru was born from a passion for transforming neglected outdoor spaces into places people want to spend time in. For nearly two decades, we've worked with Nottingham homeowners and small businesses, building gardens that look stunning and feel personal. Our reputation is built on attention to detail, reliability, and genuine care for both the plants and the people we work for.
about_para_2: Every garden is different, which is why we listen before we dig. Whether you're looking for a complete redesign, regular upkeep, or help bringing an overgrown jungle back under control, we tailor our approach to you. Our customers return year after year because they know we'll turn up on time, deliver honest advice, and treat their garden like it matters — because it does.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Gardeners Say About Us

reviews.text: Brilliant service from start to finish. The Garden Guru came out, listened to what we wanted, and completely transformed our overgrown mess into a proper family garden. Been using them for maintenance ever since. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Finally got round to sorting out the back garden and couldn't be happier. They cleared everything, redesigned it, and it's now a space we actually use. The attention to detail was impressive and they kept the mess to a minimum. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Had them do the regular fortnightly maintenance for about two years now. Really reliable blokes, always on time, and the garden looks pristine. It's freed up so much of my weekend. Great value too.
reviews.author: David H.
